questions.stem: A 21-year-old college student presents with feelings of anxiety. She explains that since starting college, she has become increasingly insecure about her weight, particularly after gaining a few kgs. To cope with the stress of her coursework and social pressures, she often binge-eats high-calorie snacks during late-night study sessions. After these episodes, she feels intense guilt and frequently induces vomiting to avoid weight gain. On physical examination, her BMI is measured at 16.5 kg/m and her heart rate is 70 beats per minute. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
